heroSummary: Federal Way Public Schools begins the 2026–27 school year on Wednesday, September 2. Kindergarten follows the district’s Kindergarten Connection schedule through September 10, with September 11 listed as the first full day for kindergarten and Bright Futures Kindergarten. The scheduled last day is Thursday, June 17, with early dismissal.
calendarNotes: FWPS schedules 28 selected Friday early releases that end 75 minutes early, beginning September 18. Kindergarten follows the Kindergarten Connection conference and half-day schedule before the first full day. Scholar-Led Conference dates in November and April are full no-school days. January 4 is a two-hour late start after Winter Break. November 25 and June 17 use separate early-dismissal schedules. Seniors finish June 10. February 16 and June 21–22 are no-school dates unless FWPS activates them as snow make-up days.

customSections.label: FWPS Shortened-Day Schedule Guide
customSections.content: FWPS uses three different shortened-day schedules. Early-release Fridays end 75 minutes early, early-dismissal dates use separate bell times, and a two-hour late start begins two hours later than normal.

customSections.content: FWPS publishes separate school-level times for regular days, Friday early releases, the November 25 early dismissal, and the June 17 early dismissal. Friday early release and the two early-dismissal dates use different bell times.

whatsNew.title: What’s Different in the 2026–27 FWPS Calendar?
content: The school year starts September 2 again, matching the 2025–26 start date.
The scheduled last day moves from June 16 in 2025–26 to June 17 in 2026–27.
Winter Break starts December 21, one day earlier than in 2025–26.
The 2026–27 calendar reserves February 16 and June 21–22 as snow make-up days if needed.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Federal Way Public Schools start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades K–12 begin Wednesday, September 2, 2026. Kindergarten follows the Kindergarten Connection conference and half-day schedule through September 10, and September 11 is listed as the first full day for kindergarten and Bright Futures Kindergarten.

calendarFaqs.q: When is FWPS Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. School resumes Monday, January 4, with a two-hour late start.

calendarFaqs.q: When is FWPS Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs April 5–9, 2027. Scholar-Led Conferences on April 1–2 are separate no-school days immediately before the weekend leading into break.

calendarFaqs.q: Does FWPS have early release every Friday?
calendarFaqs.a: No. FWPS schedules 28 selected Friday early releases in 2026–27, beginning September 18. Schools dismiss 75 minutes early on those dates; check the guide above for the complete list.

calendarFaqs.q: Are FWPS snow make-up days automatic school days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. February 16 and June 21–22 remain no-school dates unless FWPS activates them after a closure. Check district announcements before making plans around those dates.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed against FWPS’s live calendar, Back-to-School Hub, early-release and bell-schedule pages, district profile, and official 2026–27 calendar PDFs.
sourceReviewDetails: The live calendar lists September 11 as the first full day for kindergarten and Bright Futures Kindergarten under “2 Hours Late Start.” The April 3 school-year PDF does not mark September 11 as a late-start day, so families should confirm the start time with their school or FWPS.
The Back-to-School Hub lists September 9 for Full-Day ECEAP and September 14 for Developmental Preschool and Part-Day ECEAP.
The official early-release page confirms 28 selected Fridays and a 75-minute schedule reduction.
The bell-schedule page provides separate school-level times for Friday early release, November 25 early dismissal, and June 17 early dismissal.
FWPS reports 121 languages spoken among district families and publishes the school-year calendar in English plus seven translated versions.
